first.rationale: The immediate competitive threat is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, and inherited evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing lifted both qualified acquisition and revenue in that segment across billing plans. I would verify that result and the onboarding alternative before committing, because discounting can impair unit economics or attract lower-quality demand. A standard, tightly targeted experiment can measure qualified revenue, conversion, retention proxies, and discount dependence while avoiding a broad pricing change.
